office_does: The auditor runs county elections and voter registration, records documents such as deeds, issues vehicle and vessel licenses, and keeps the county's financial records.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Matt Beaton (Prefers Republican Party), in office since 2011, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Franklin County Auditor since 2011 and a former real estate appraiser; the only candidate on the ballot.
highlights: Auditor since 2011; earlier owned an appraisal firm [S1]
Consolidated the Elections Division at a new Pasco location [S1]
Wants state cooperation with federal voter-roll checks: 'Trust but verify' [S1]
